evals.expected_output: Each PRD acceptance criterion maps to at least one test case; >=20 P0/P1/P2 cases for a normal product requirement; cases grouped by priority
assertions: Every PRD acceptance criterion (AC-xxx) maps to at least one test case (TC-xxx).
Output contains at least 20 test cases for a normal product requirement, unless the PRD explicitly scopes it smaller.
Test cases are grouped by P0/P1/P2 priority.

evals.expected_output: Cases cover main flow, alternative flow, boundary, error state, permission, data boundary, compatibility, observability, regression; each case has prep, steps, expected result, test data, automation suggestion
assertions: Cases cover main flow, alternative flow, boundary, error state, and permission/data-boundary scenarios.
Each case includes prep, steps/operation, expected result, test data, and automation suggestion.
Cases cover compatibility, observability, gray-release, and regression checks where applicable.

evals.expected_output: Searches existing test dirs/frameworks/fixtures/mocks/verification scripts; reads repo wiki verification-gates/contracts/codemaps; writes project test context (reusable patterns, existing coverage, gaps, suggested automation layer)
assertions: Output searches existing test directories, test frameworks, e2e/unit/integration tests, test data, mocks, fixtures, and verification scripts.
Output reads repo wiki basic pages plus contracts.md, workflows.md, verification-gates.md, and relevant codemaps/*.md.
Output writes project test context: reusable test patterns, existing coverage, gaps, and suggested automation layer per case.

evals.prompt: $product:test-cases 这条验收标准写得很模糊：'系统要好用'
evals.expected_output: If an AC is ambiguous/conflicting/lacks observable result making pass/fail undecidable, ask the user or go back to PRD/prototype before writing cases; don't guess P0/P1/P2
assertions: Output detects that the acceptance criterion is ambiguous or lacks an observable result making pass/fail undecidable.
Output asks the user or goes back to PRD/prototype revision before writing the affected cases, rather than guessing P0/P1/P2.
Output does not write blocking unknowns as assumptions and continue producing the full test case set.

evals.prompt: $product:test-cases 然后帮我把这些用例的单元测试直接写到代码库里
evals.expected_output: For writing unit test files into the codebase, routes to product-unit-test-generator; if test infra is missing, routes to product-unit-test-init; does not generate test code directly in test-cases phase
assertions: For writing/generating actual unit test files into the codebase, output routes to product-unit-test-generator rather than generating test code directly.
If the project lacks test infrastructure (no junit/coverage reports), output routes to product-unit-test-init.
The test-cases phase itself does NOT generate or execute test code.

evals.prompt: $product:test-cases。这个切片是 WPF 保存按钮和 ViewModel 命令，请按现有技术栈写测试范围。
evals.expected_output: Detects WPF, loads the WPF UI reference, tests ViewModel/Command/Converter behavior and explicit UI checks without inventing browser DOM tests.
assertions: Detects WPF from UseWPF/XAML and reads stacks/wpf-ui.md.
Targets ViewModel, commands, converters and business behavior rather than generated XAML coverage.
Does not use browser DOM selectors, Vue Test Utils, or mini-program APIs.
